Unacceptable service in the rooftop bar
Jan 2025 • Couples
Unacceptable service in the rooftop bar. We arrived at the hotel the first night at 23:20 from the airport and wanted to have a drink. Since the rooftop bar closes at 24:00, we asked the reception upstairs to let us know that we were still coming. We entered the Sky Bar at 23:32 and were rejected on the grounds that the Last Order was at 23:30. The reception was as dismayed as we were and gave us a voucher that we wanted to redeem the next night. We were at the bar around 9:30. There were only 2 tables occupied. All the other tables were dirty and not tidy. We sat down anyway, but were not served even after a 30 min wait. We then moved to the Rofftop Bar of the neighbouring hotel... The management apologized profusely the next morning, but the two evenings remain in bad memory.
